title: Scripture and Culture
definition: Scripture and culture must be rightly ordered because God's Word judges every culture while also speaking redemptively into every people and place.
summary: Believers are called to love people within culture without being conformed to sinful patterns that oppose God.
christFocus: Christ sends His people into the world with the truth of the Gospel while forming them by His Word.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Scripture and Culture teaches that God's people must receive this truth under the authority of the Lord, allowing Scripture itself to define the doctrine rather than personal opinion, tradition, or culture.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it protects the believer from confusion and helps the church remain anchored in what God has actually spoken. Without this truth, faith can drift toward feelings, assumptions, or human wisdom.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: A disciple should respond to scripture and culture by reading the Word prayerfully, testing beliefs by Scripture, obeying what God reveals, and helping others handle the Bible with humility, clarity, and faith.

studySections.heading: Guardrails and Common Errors
studySections.content: This doctrine should not be used to win arguments while neglecting love, nor should it be separated from prayer, obedience, and dependence on the Holy Spirit. The goal is faithful submission to God, not mere possession of information.

sources: Scripture references listed in this doctrine entry.
